data.content: U.S. Men's National Soccer Team. # USMNT projected lineup vs Chile: Will Pochettino rotate his side? The U.S. men's national team looks to make it two wins from two in the post-World Cup era on Tuesday, Sept. 29, as it hosts Chile in St. Louis. In a match that saw 11 players earn their first caps, the USMNT beat Peru 4-1 in Orlando on Saturday, Sept. Two of those debutants, Justin Ellis and Julian Hall, scored in their first USMNT match, while Malik Tillman and Sebastian Berhalter also found the net. With a quick turnaround and two more games after the Chile match, Mauricio Pochettino will likely opt for a healthy amount of rotation on Tuesday at Energizer Park. data.content: # Portugal XI vs Norway – Predicted lineup and team news. **On Sunday,** **Portugal** **and** **Norway** **face off in their second UEFA Nations League group-stage meeting at Oslo's Ullevaal Stadion.**. Portugal come into this fixture with a winning start to their Nations League campaign but show uneven form overall. ## Portugal team news. Left-back Nuno Mendes is dealing with late muscle fatigue picked up in the Wales win, but medical staff expect him to be available for selection. He is likely to be supported on the flanks by João Félix, who keeps his place after scoring the decisive goal in the 1-0 victory over Wales. ## Portugal predicted lineup. ## When will the match kick off? The match will kick off at 7:45pm BST on Sunday, 27th September. In the United Kingdom, the Norway vs Portugal UEFA Nations League group match will be streamed live online via Amazon Prime Video.
